title: Crash Racers
tagline: Race the robot cars through Ubud, Helsinki and Montreal. The right present gives you a boost!
howToPlay: 🏁 Race: beat the three robot cars to the finish. The pill at the top shows your place (like 2nd of 4) and the cars in order. At each present gate, tap (or steer with ◀ ▶) to the present the house would like: the right present gives you a burst of speed to pass, a wrong one simply gives none, so thinking at the gates is how you win. Three right in a row bring three lanes of harder presents; two more and the gate shows 🗺️, so you find whose gate is next from the pins on the map. The step you reach carries into the next race. At the finish, the podium shows everyone's place, and the results show what each missed house wanted. In 🧸 Easy mode the car drives itself, bumps are soft and the robots race at your speed; turn Easy off for faster robots, 🔥 turbo and coloured lanes on the road. 🎪 Bumpers: gentle bumper cars with the same present gates, park when you like. 🔊 turns the sound off.
learning: Matching things by kind (who would like which present) and reading a map
